# Cuemath

> > Cuemath is an online K-12 math learning platform offering personalized one-on-one tutoring with certified tutors and gamified learning through MathFit.

Cuemath provides live math classes and interactive learning experiences for students from kindergarten through 12th grade. The platform combines certified math tutors with proprietary tools like MathFit to deliver personalized, engaging math education that adapts to each student's learning pace and style.

## Key Topics

- Online Math Tutoring
- MathFit
- Personalized Learning
- One-on-One Tutoring
- K-12 Education
- Certified Tutors
- Gamified Learning
- Live Math Classes
- Adaptive Learning Platform
- Student-Centered Education
